scope: Independent pre-implementation contract/placement/source review of the two-site correction for supported scripted GizmoGroup callbacks producing pixels before or without selected gizmo drawing.

finding_acknowledged.host: Stock Windows Blender5.1.2, not target iOS
finding_acknowledged.observation: Registered persistent Python VIEW3D group with zero gizmos emitted171444 exact magenta pixels from draw_prepare; unregister removed all. Pinned5.0 source has the same callback-before-gizmo-list route.
finding_acknowledged.implication: Existing per-selected-gizmo marks are insufficient to classify every supported script group pixel source. Existing exact run40252354359 must not be presented as ready merely from the prior bridge pass.

approved_contract.placement: Immediately after flag-only wm_gizmogroup_is_visible_in_drawstep passes, before modal-exclusion branching and before the first group poll/setup/setup_keymap/refresh/draw_prepare callback.
approved_contract.condition: gzgroup->type->rna_ext.call is nonnull. Guard region and runtime when accessing the current drawing region; mark both ipad_finger_paint_overlay_blocked and ipad_knife_canvas_unknown_widgets true.
approved_contract.why: The script can draw from poll even when poll returnsfalse, from setup/refresh before hiding, or draw_prepare while gizmo list staysempty. Marking before these routes keeps exposure sticky even if a callback removes or hides its own group. Marking only when draw_prepare is nonnull or after poll/ensure_init would leave supported gaps.
approved_contract.parity: Do not skip callbacks or change return values/draw lists/order/refresh flags. Fixed native builtin groups with ext.call==null retain the old path. Apple-only marking only changes unsafe receipt admission.

approved_contract.placement: At each current group entry before inspecting/iterating the gizmo list and before name-based known_navigation can grant any exemption.
approved_contract.condition: For a nonnull group->type whose rna_ext.call is nonnull, set r_native.settled=false unconditionally. Keep the existing null-type refusal.
approved_contract.why: The query must remain callback-free and cannot determine whether a scripted group is currently harmless by polling it. The refusal must include empty, hidden, uninitialized, removal-tagged and newly added group instances. No state-vector field is required because fresh unsettled already makes current hierarchy inadmissible.
approved_contract.parity: Existing group/gizmo snapshots and builtin navigation footprint logic remain intact. Conservative refusal of a registered hidden/empty script group is intended; it does not hide or disable that group.

source_checks.evidence: wm_gizmogroup_is_visible_in_drawstep only switches drawstep and checks WM_GIZMOGROUPTYPE_3D flag. It invokes no poll/callback, so the proposed first mark still precedes arbitrary script preparation.

Drawstep visibility precedes modal exclusion and WM_gizmo_group_type_poll; WM_gizmogroup_ensure_init runs before hide.any check; draw_prepare runs before the group gizmo-list loop. Empty gizmo lists do not suppress these callback routes.
ensure_init invokes setup, setup_keymap and refresh. Group poll invokes type.poll; callbacks have no bounded pixel-footprint guarantee.

Supported RNA GizmoGroup registration always assigns dummy_wgt.rna_ext.call=call alongside .srna/.data/.free and installs whichever optional trampolines are defined. The poll/setup/refresh/draw_prepare trampolines dispatch through that same ext.call. Testing ext.call captures the supported opaque script route without invoking it.

Builtin group type allocation and Python append_ptr paths remain distinct; ordinary native builtin callbacks are part of the fixed pin. The reviewed correction does not claim to classify arbitrary injected native callbacks.

Frame markers reset at the existing draw boundary. Knife stamp_finish copies runtime unknown_widgets into the buffer stamp after region drawing; Finger paint buffer copies overlay_blocked. Cached textures preserve their exclusion facts. Current absence/removal of a group must not clear these stamped marks before a completed clean redraw.

Current native capture already returns a settled field checked by fresh hierarchy admission, while EDprobe additionally refuses buffer/composition/runtime unknown markers. The proposed settled=false and sticky draw markers cover current-state and previously drawn pixels independently.

callback_identification_judgment.reason: Within the pinned builtin code plus supported Python/RNA GizmoGroup registration, ext.call is canonical positive evidence that group preparation can dispatch opaque script code. It is broader and safer than detecting only draw_prepare, class name, nonempty gizmos or current poll result. Requiring a fixed native function-address whitelist would broaden the intended correction without additional supported-route evidence.
callback_identification_judgment.native_navigation_name: Root separately verified builtin calloc extension.srna is null and RNA duplicate registration rejects replacement. Additionally, unconditional ext.call refusal must apply even if a script group name resembles native navigation; do not make the new condition subordinate to known_navigation.

focused_validation_requirements_before_b: Exercise the actual extracted gizmomap_prepare_drawing body with scripted empty group draw_prepare, poll-false direct output, setup/refresh leading to hide, self-removal and no selected gizmos. Both exclusion markers must already be true when the callback begins and remain true afterward.
Confirm wrong-drawstep groups run no preparation callbacks in that pass; native ext.call-null groups retain exact callback order, draw selection and marker behavior.

Exercise actual hierarchy_native_capture with scripted empty/hidden/uninitialized/new/removal-tagged group: settledfalse without any poll/setup/draw/hit invocation. ext.call-null native cases retain prior outcomes.
Confirm removal after a drawn script frame still refuses cached stamped pixels; only completed clean redraw with fresh matching hierarchy can reacquire the original live Knife receipt.

Keep existing callback/owner/token/keyboard/unknown-widget assertions and raw failure evidence unchanged. Build only after actual edited source, focused/full required tests, exact patch scope and independent edited-source review pass.
limits: This reviews the proposed two-site contract against actual current/pinned source and the preserved real host counterexample. It is not validation of edits that have not yet been inspected, a native corrected binary, iOS behavior, or final readiness.

Native builtins are treated as the audited fixed pin. Arbitrary C++ plugin injection, direct in-process callback-pointer corruption, global memory corruption and arbitrary allocator/registration substitution are outside this bounded correction claim.
No production/test/source edits, builds or device actions performed by this reviewer. Only this independent review artifact is added.
